title: A Postreconstruction Harmonization Method for Multicenter Radiomic Studies in PET

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《A Postreconstruction Harmonization Method for Multicenter Radiomic Studies in PET》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Several reports have shown that radiomic features are affected by acquisition and reconstruction parameters, thus hampering multicenter studies.

evidence.text: Several reports have shown that radiomic features are affected by acquisition and reconstruction parameters, thus hampering multicenter studies.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《A Postreconstruction Harmonization Method for Multicenter Radiomic Studies in PET》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】We propose a method that, by removing the center effect while preserving patient-specific effects, standardizes features measured from PET images obtained using different imaging protocols.

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】Methods: Pretreatment 18F-FDG PET images of patients with breast cancer were included.

evidence.text: We propose a method that, by removing the center effect while preserving patient-specific effects, standardizes features measured from PET images obtained using different imaging protocols.
Methods: Pretreatment 18F-FDG PET images of patients with breast cancer were included.
